description: delegation: a multi-line fix (new edge case in mean) is dispatched to the implement model and audited before the push

issues.title: mean() fails when the input has missing values
issues.body:
`calc.mean([1, None, 3])` raises `TypeError` because `None` is summed.

Missing readings arrive as `None` and should be ignored, so the mean above is 2.

`make test` shows `test_mean_skips_none` and `test_mean_all_none` failing.

Acceptance:
- `mean` ignores `None` entries when averaging
- `mean` raises `ValueError` when the input is empty or holds only `None`
- existing behavior for plain numbers is unchanged
- make test passes
